C0376.title: Phishing Campaign Targeting YouTubers with Fake Starfield Developer Emails
C0376.summary: Attackers exploited anticipation for the game Starfield by posing as its developers, launching a large-scale phishing attack against YouTube gaming creators. The campaign used phishing emails to steal their YouTube accounts, demonstrating a typical account takeover technique that uses impersonation to obtain login credentials.

references.title: Numerous bloggers scammed by Starfield phishing email; fraudsters impersonate developers to steal accounts - Gaming
